# Tellen Automation

> AI receptionist, scheduling, lead qualification, follow-up, and custom
> workflow automation for small service businesses. Veteran-founded.
> Serves Southern California.

## What we do
- AI receptionist — answers calls and chat, captures caller/visitor details, routes requests
- Appointment scheduling — connects booking to the calendar or tools a business already uses
- Lead follow-up — captures inquiries and keeps follow-up consistent
- Business automation — connects repetitive tasks across everyday tools
- Voice and chat AI — customer-facing conversations with human handoff paths
- Custom AI agents — tailored workflows built around a specific business's processes

## Who we work with
Small service businesses, with particular focus on:
- HVAC and plumbing (after-hours inquiries, service request qualification, urgent-issue routing)
- Property management (tenant requests, maintenance coordination, escalation paths)
- Professional and local service businesses more broadly

## Where we work
Southern California.

## Pricing
Proposed starting rates in USD, subject to a signed agreement — not binding offers.
Telephony minutes, AI tokens, SMS, third-party software, and taxes are additional
unless stated in a signed proposal.
- Starter: $497/month, proposed $750 one-time setup — one AI receptionist or core
  workflow, basic lead capture and notifications, one calendar/integration,
  business-hours email support, monthly performance summary
- Growth: $997/month, proposed $1,500 one-time setup — AI receptionist plus lead
  follow-up, appointment booking and reminders, up to three supported workflows,
  CRM/calendar integrations, priority business-hours support, monthly optimization
  review
- Enterprise: custom, implementation quoted separately — custom agents and
  multi-step workflows, multiple locations/departments, advanced integrations and
  permissions, tailored human escalation rules
- Optional add-ons: SMS follow-up module (+$99/month), advanced reporting (+$149/month)

- Call the live AI receptionist: +1 (213) 772-7402
- Chat with it on the website (chat widget, bottom right)
- Book a free 30-minute consultation via the website contact form

## AI disclosure and human oversight
Responses may be generated by AI and can be mistaken, incomplete, or
misinterpreted. Important decisions and sensitive requests should be reviewed
by a person. AI-enabled calls or messages are disclosed where required by law.
